blocks.text: NEW YORK–The search for a successor to WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert is well underway with more than a dozen candidates in the mix so far. Engelbert, who will retire at the end of the calendar year after serving in the position since 2019, said she hasn’t interviewed anyone yet, but most likely would start once the list is narrowed down. Engelbert presided over her final board of governors meeting Monday with representatives from all 15 teams as well as the three expansion franchises that will join the league over the next four years — Cleveland, Detroit and Philadelphia.
